reviews.text: I understand having ads and for a free game, I can’t really complain. This game takes it over the top though. I’ve never left a review for any app ever before, but I’ve just never had one make me so angry lol. Having an ad after every single level is excessive but I can accept it. But this game will literally play an ad if you just swipe away from the game for one second. I haven’t even fully gone to play, i’ve basically only been watching ads on here. I think I’ve probably made it two levels. I don’t know. A lot of games like this will make the first few levels ad free so they can get you hooked I assume. This game starts the ad bombing right from the beginning, at least I can respect that 😂 deleted and onto the next.
